messages:
support_jess: Hey team — escalation from a paying customer. After upgrading to SDK v1.4.2 their embedding calls started returning inconsistent vector lengths and we saw a large billing spike from repeated retries. Attaching quick logs and repro. @eng-oncall can you triage?
support_jess: Symptoms: some responses come back with dim=1536 (expected for redwood-embed-1) and others return dim=1024. Intermittent HTTP 401s on the same account around the same time, client retries seem to cause duplicate successful calls. Customer noticed cost jump overnight.
support_jess: Logs (redacted):
```
REQUEST 1938765432 POST /v1/embeddings model=redwood-embed-1 batch_size=64 X-Req-Id=rc-abc123
> 200 OK content: {"data":[{"embedding_length":1536},{"embedding_length":1536}]}
REQUEST 1938765440 POST /v1/embeddings model=redwood-embed-1 batch_size=64 X-Req-Id=rc-abc124
> 401 Unauthorized content: {"error":"token expired"}
REQUEST 1938765443 POST /v1/embeddings model=redwood-embed-1 batch_size=64 X-Req-Id=rc-abc125
> 200 OK content: {"data":[{"embedding_length":1024},{"embedding_length":1024}]}
```
dave_support: Repro steps customer ran (Python):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
inputs = ["text1"]*128
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="redwood-embed-1", input=inputs, batch_size=64, timeout=30)
```
They reported retries are automatic in their network layer.
eng_oncall: Thanks. First quick asks: which region, account id, and do we have full request IDs for the 401s? Also did the client explicitly retry on 401? We should avoid recharging on auth failures.
support_jess: Region us-west2, acct: acct-prod-78, request ids: rc-abc124, rc-abc125, rc-abc127. Customer network retried on 401 after 3s backoff.
ben_engineer: Looking at router logs: rc-abc125 routed to older quantized variant (fallback-serving) due to capacity in primary pool. That variant is a 1024-dim model. So the server returned a compatible vector but with different dims. SDK didn't validate dims and client code assumed fixed length -> mismatch.
carla_reliability: Important: we should never silently fall back to a different embedding dimension. That breaks clients. Proposal: router should only fallback to same-dim compatible variants; otherwise return 4xx that indicates model incompatibility. I'll file a patch.
ben_engineer: Also the 401s: token checks showed a short-lived KMS rotation for one API key during the window, which produced intermittent 401s. The customer-side retry logic retried the entire batch, which produced duplicate successful calls afterwards. So two issues: server-side routing to wrong-dim variant + retries after auth failure.
carla_reliability: Mitigation steps for customer while we patch:
- Pin model version (model="redwood-embed-1@v2025-02-01") to prevent routing to legacy variant.
- Reduce client batch_size to 32 and limit concurrency to <=8 to reduce chance of hitting fallback.
- Make SDK treat 401 as fatal for that request (no automatic retry) — we should update docs.
ben_engineer: Also add server-side change: when fallback differs in embedding size, return 400 with body: {"error":"incompatible_model_variant","expected_dim":1536,"actual_dim":1024} so SDKs can surface a clear error.
dave_support: Quick interim workaround provided to customer, they confirmed billing spike stopped after disabling retries for 401. They still saw one run with 1024 dims after pinning model (maybe a cached route).
eng_oncall: For SDK-level quickfixs:
- Validate embedding length in response and raise a specific exception if it doesn't match expected dim.
- Add an opt-in `idempotency_key` header on embeddings.create so duplicates can be deduped server-side.
- Update retry policy: treat 401 as no-retry; 5xx and 429 use exponential backoff with jitter.
support_jess: TS snippet we gave customer that reproduced mismatch:
```ts
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const out = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'redwood-embed-1', input: Array(128).fill('x'), batch_size: 64 });
console.log(out.data[0].embedding.length); // sometimes 1024
```
ben_engineer: Found one more thing: older router cache had stale variant mapping for that account for ~5 minutes post-rotation. I'll clear caches and add a mapping TTL change.
carla_reliability: I'll open a PR for router behavior (disallow cross-dim fallback), and a second PR to emit metrics when fallback happens so we can alert.
ben_engineer: I'll prepare a runtime fix to prefer returning 400 on incompatible fallback and add idempotency support. Eng-oncall, can you coordinate release?
eng_oncall: Yep. I will:
- Create incident ticket with P0 label, assign to runtime and router teams.
- Patch router to reject cross-dim fallbacks (canary in us-west2).
- Add server-side idempotency header handling.
- Coordinate SDK doc update re: 401 retry behavior.
support_jess: Customer update: after disabling client retries for 401 and pinning model, they saw normal dims and no more cost spike. They want confirmation of long-term fix and an explanation of what happened.
carla_reliability: We'll send root-cause writeup when PRs land. For now, customer-facing note: "Intermittent auth token rotation + router fallback to a legacy 1024-dim variant caused mismatched embeddings; client retries after 401 amplified calls. Workaround: pin model version and avoid retrying on 401. We've deployed a fix to prevent cross-dim fallback." :thumbsup:
ben_engineer: Action items: runtime PR #3421, router PR #3422, SDK doc PR #3423, follow-up postmortem.
support_jess: Thanks everyone, reopening if anything else.
